body:
💀 GiveMeYourHead
GiveMeYourHead is a simple yet essential plugin for any competitive Minecraft server. Whether you are running a hardcore survival world or a high-stakes PvP arena, this plugin adds a rewarding twist to every player encounter.
🌟 Why use GiveMeYourHead?
True Identity: Every dropped head features the exact Skin and Player Name of the fallen player.
Lightweight & Fast: Coded to be extremely efficient, ensuring your server's performance remains smooth.
Instant Setup: No configuration files to mess with—just install and you're ready to go.
Trophy System: Perfect for creating "Wall of Shame" or "Hall of Fame" areas in your spawn or base.
🛠️ Installation Guide:
Download the GiveMeYourHead.jar file.
Upload it to your server's /plugins/ directory.
Restart your server.
Kill your friends (or enemies) and take what's yours!
📜 Technical Details:
Platform: Compatible with Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and other Bukkit-based forks.
Version: Supports most modern Minecraft versions
